courses.summary: 諾赫地下天然氣儲存是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為低熱值氣服務與季節需求之間的匹配；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: Norg Storage is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on matching low-calorific gas service with seasonal demand, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
